Bug: EmptyState customArt prop leaks to DOM (React warning)
Notes: Fixed by destructuring icon + customArt out of ...rest spread before motion.div

Bug: Dates display as previous day in dashboard
Notes: Fixed isToday + history getBucket to use provider timezone via en-CA date strings. Also fixed clients/[id] formatDate signature.

Bug: New bookings missing from upcoming / Today view
Notes: Same root cause as date display bug - tz filtering. Closed by the same fix.

Bug: Reschedule confirmation appointment doesnt show in dashboard
Notes: Same root cause as above - tz filtering. Closed by the same fix.

Bug: No email sent after rescheduling appointment
Notes: Added reschedule branch to PATCH handler - re-sends booking confirmation + reschedules reminders

Bug: No email sent after paying remaining balance
Notes: Added sendBalanceReceipt to lib/email.ts and wired into BALANCE branch of webhook

Bug: Reschedule slot picker flashes 'no times available' before fetch
Notes: Made slots state nullable. Loading state covers the race window.

Bug: 'Send payment link' has no UI confirmation on dashboard
Notes: Added toast: 'Payment link sent to client'

Bug: Calendar icon invisible on date inputs (same color as bg)
Notes: Added webkit-calendar-picker-indicator filter tinted to ink-500

Bug: Dark mode toggle was broken (added class but nothing changed visually)
Notes: Removed entirely - brand is light-only like Aesop/PMG/Resy

Bug: R2 portfolio + cover uploads failed silently
Notes: Two fixes: (1) CSP connect-src missing *.r2.cloudflarestorage.com (2) Bucket CORS policy not set

Bug: Cover image too prominent on wide screens
Notes: Switched to X/Twitter pattern - full-bleed 2:1 mobile / 6:1 desktop banner with avatar overlap

Bug: Cover crop modal needed for upload
Notes: Built new modal mirroring AvatarCropModal but with 3:1 rectangular crop + grid guides

Bug: Worker dies on Neon idle disconnect
Notes: Symptom: 'Server has closed the connection' in worker logs after extended idle. Workaround: restart pnpm dev. Real fix: Prisma retry wrapper.

Bug: Stripe CLI test_mode_api_key expires after long inactivity
Notes: Workaround: stripe config --set test_mode_api_key sk_test_... directly. Avoids the browser-based stripe login flow.
